verdict_reason: The two new tests correctly pin the clear-search link's presence/absence, but neither asserts where the link goes, and the data-testid contract they introduce is left untested on the no-results branch where the template omits it.

todos.issue: The new 'shows clear search when search results are returned' test never asserts the clear-search link's href — 'toContain("Clear search")' and the data-testid string match regardless of destination, so AC1's 'clear the search and return to the full list' is unpinned (changing href to /address-book?q=green would keep the test green).
todos.fix: Parse with Cheerio and assert the destination, e.g. expect(load(result)('[data-testid="address-book-clear-search"]').attr('href')).toBe('/address-book'), replacing the raw 'Clear search' string match.

todos.issue: The PR introduces a data-testid contract for the clear-search link but only tests the has-results branch; the no-results branch (index.njk:65) renders a 'Clear search' link with no data-testid, and the pre-existing no-results test at line 238 only asserts toContain('Clear search'), so the two branches expose different selectors and nothing catches it.
todos.fix: Add expect(result).toContain('data-testid="address-book-clear-search"') to the 'shows no-results state...' test at line 221 (it will fail), then add the same data-testid to the no-results Clear search link in index.njk so both branches share one selector.
